class Defaulted {
  value;
  constructor(skip: boolean) {
    ((value = (this.value = 1)) => {})(skip ? 0 : undefined);
  }
}
class Destructured {
  value;
  constructor() {
    (({ inner: { number = (this.value = 2) } = {} } = {}) => {})();
  }
}
class OptionalImmediate {
  value;
  constructor() {
    (() => { this.value = 4; })?.();
  }
}
console.log(new Defaulted(false).value, new Defaulted(true).value ?? 0, new Destructured().value, new OptionalImmediate().value);
